- Time: \(O(N L J)\)
- Memory: \(O(N J)\)

N is the number of pixels, L the number of filter taps and J the number of levels. Each level of the stationary transform works on the whole image. Cycle spinning costs n^2 runs of wavelet thresholding, each O(N L).
